suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: First session
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex's $190 first session with Maya, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, after a free fit check call. A card is saved, nothing taken. The desk checks Alex's plan by hand, and what's owed goes on the saved card when Maya texts DONE: nobody is at the desk on Saturdays.

suggested_services.name: First session
suggested_services.example: The same first session when the front desk is open: Alex pays at the desk. The saved card is only for the $75 late-cancel fee, with Sam's yes.

suggested_services.name: First session
suggested_services.example: The same session for a fee-free client, whose plan bars missed-session fees: nothing is taken and no card is saved. Anything owed is paid at the front desk.

suggested_services.name: First in-home session
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex, who can't easily leave home, pays for a $179 first in-home session with David, Thu Oct 22 at 8:00am. A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel fee, and the $179 is charged at DONE. The receipt has what Alex's plan needs to pay Alex back.

suggested_services.name: First in-home session
suggested_services.example: The same session when Alex's plan pays in network and bars late fees: nothing is taken, no card is saved, and the office bills the plan its own way.

intake_questions.never_asked: the reason for therapy, symptoms, diagnoses, medicine names and a child's details are never asked in the AI chat or by text: only on the secure page
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a teen alone only where the state's form lets a teen consent and the practice turns it on (a switch); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; someone else may pay, but the client agrees for themselves

stop.say: If you're thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 now. If you're in danger right now, call 911.
stop.booking: 988 and 911 first, at once, every time; danger right now, unsure, or no answer: no booking in that chat; only a person who clearly says they're safe now and still wants to book may go on: the AI says a first session may be days away and 988 is there any time, and a clinician is told the same day; a booking never stands in for 988 or 911

stop.words: harming someone else, or anyone in danger right now
stop.say: If anyone is in danger, get to safety and call 911 now. You can also call or text 988.
stop.booking: no booking; if the person is already a client, the owner is alerted at once, any hour, under the office's crisis rule

go_on.words: not feeling safe at home (someone there hurts or threatens them)
go_on.what: 911 if anyone is in danger now; then the booking goes on, reaching the person only the safe way they pick

go_on.words: stress, worry, poor sleep or feeling low, with nothing above
go_on.what: no safety message; matched to a first session; Rosie never judges how serious anything is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen on every message, call and intake answer: danger to life, a medical emergency or self-harm gets 911 or 988; Rosie never counsels or gives advice, only booking

steps.name: Fit check call
steps.when: before the first session, at least a day before; booked with it on one secure link
steps.result: a good fit: the first session stands; another therapist fits better: the client OKs the change; not a fit: cancelled with nothing charged, and a clinician calls with other options

steps.name: Intake forms and consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before; one reminder
steps.who: every client, and each adult in a couples or family session
steps.result: not done: the owner keeps the session (signed on the secure page before it starts), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the desk, by hand
steps.who: every client who names a plan
steps.result: covered (the copay shows), some services only, not covered (self-pay, or a free cancel), or can't check now (the desk checks by the next business day)

steps.name: A written good-faith estimate
steps.when: told while booking; sent on time, as the federal rules say
steps.result: a to-do for the desk, with its due date; Rosie delivers it and records when

steps.name: The plan's OK for sessions ahead
steps.when: where a plan asks for it, by the desk on the plan's own website
steps.result: the desk records the sessions approved and the end date; Rosie warns before they run out

steps.name: Past records
steps.when: only with the client's signed OK
steps.who: where the therapist asks for them
steps.result: office to office, never through Rosie; a session isn't held up for them

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for a video session, a quiet, private place and a charged phone; for a home session, a room with a door; the intake forms done the day before

staff.skills: who sees adults, teens, couples and families; who offers video and home sessions; who speaks which language; how each lists themselves (like a woman or a man) for clients who ask
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each therapist's own license, per state, and any compact privilege; an associate's supervisor on file
staff.supervision: an associate works only under the supervisor the state's form sets (a switch)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day sessions, new clients where he turns that on, any custom price and every sliding-scale fee, and anything a therapist flags
staff.stand_in: a client's therapist is never changed without the client's own yes; a stand-in is offered only with the same skills and what the client asked for, like a woman

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a teen alone only where the state's form lets a teen consent and the practice turns it on (a switch); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; someone else may pay, but the client agrees for themselves
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's texts go to the parent or guardian, unless the state's form lets the teen consent alone and the practice turns that on
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a teen, at what age a teen may consent alone, and whether a parent is told (switches from the state's form)

visit.check_in: at the office: the code at the front desk, or to the therapist when nobody is at the desk; by video: read out at the start; at home: the code at the door
visit.done: the code or DONE; session notes stay in the practice's own record, never in Rosie or a text; Rosie keeps only booking notes
visit.changes_at_visit: nothing is added during a session; a longer session is booked ahead; the next step, like a weekly time, is agreed in the room and confirmed by the client's own yes by text
visit.before_work: the therapist reads the intake forms; at a video session, the therapist confirms the client's name and where they are, for the license and in case of an emergency (Rosie's rule everywhere, and the state's form where it requires it)

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each therapist holds their own active license from the state's board for their kind of license (like a counselor, a social worker, a marriage and family therapist or a psychologist); the state's form says which licenses may give therapy
license.who: each person; the practice too, where the state's form registers therapy practices (a switch)
license.ask: each person's license type and number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); an associate's supervisor; the practice's registration number, where the state's form asks for one
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form or a plan asks for it

never_in_a_text: client texts carry only the display name, the date, the time, the place and a secure link: never 'therapy', 'counseling', the kind of session, a reason, a diagnosis, a medicine name or a child's details; at the office, never the therapist's name (it's on the secure page); at home, the therapist's name and photo stay, for the door check; the video link stays on the secure page
